evals.name: serverconfig-new-suite
evals.prompt: 按 docs/TEST_TARGETS.md，给 ISource2ServerConfig 写一个 suite。
evals.expected_output: A complete suite (.h/.cpp) registered in TestRunner + CMakeLists + suites/README.md, with every ISource2ServerConfig method either called or SkipCall'd with a reason, IAppSystem base slots covered, and type-level (not semantic) assertions.

evals.name: gameentities-hooks
evals.prompt: 给 ISource2GameEntities 加个测试套件，这个接口引擎会调进游戏，所以 hook 也要覆盖上。
evals.expected_output: Suite with pre/post hook pairs, Declare() before install, MRES_IGNORED returns, SafeStringArg/pointer vetting in handlers, and full method accounting.

evals.name: review-existing
evals.prompt: 帮我 review 一下 src/suites/Source2ServerSuite.cpp，看有没有漏测的接口方法或者该测没测的结构体布局。
evals.expected_output: Uses the audit script (or equivalent exact-match check) to verify method accounting, consults the struct registry before recommending new layout checks, and does not recommend re-inspecting a struct another suite already owns.
